free_tier.stated: No free tier and no hourly or daily rental: a real Mac dedicated to you is $90 per month, rented month to month. Prices are in US dollars, plus applicable taxes.
free_tier.notes: The iPhone tier is a separate device at $60 a month and is not this record. The provider list's $90 a month divided by 730 hours is $0.123 an hour.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a dedicated physical Mac, not an object; no storage size is published on the pages read

retention.stated: When you release it, we erase your data and reset it; the device is factory-reset on connect and wiped clean on release, and the controller is wiped and reset too

egress.terms: not published: the pages read state no egress allowance, price or data cap for the Mac tier

interface_detail: through a dedicated controller, the agent sees the screen and taps, types and clicks; Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenClaw and Hermes connect through the Glasshand API; the user approves and pays in the agent chat
tooling: an AI agent that can call the Glasshand API and interpret screenshots; no SSH, CLI or SDK is documented on the pages read
chaining: the dedicated Mac runs Xcode builds and native-app tests under an agent's screen control, and signed-in apps and files stay on the device until release; bytes that must outlive a release need a separate storage record because the device is erased on release.

limits.value: $90 a month, billed monthly with no hourly or daily option; cancel anytime and the device stays available until the end of the current billing period

limits_note: unverified: no published limit on device count, concurrent tasks, network throughput or session length was found on the pages read
binding_note: the month-to-month rental with no hourly option is the only published constraint; no egress or request quota is stated.

identity_cost.detail: the sign-in page asks for an email address and sends a sign-in code with no password: 'We’ll send you a sign-in code. No password needed.' The pricing page's Rent a Mac link leads to app.glasshand.com/login, where payment is approved when the agent asks; whether a card is required to rent is unverified: behind a sign-up.

reliability_note: the device is factory-reset on connect and all data plus the controller are erased on release; the pages read state no uptime guarantee or throttle
confidence_note: the price, monthly billing, device erasure, real-hardware claim and no-hourly answer are quoted from first-party pages read on 2026-11-25; the sign-in gate is quoted from app.glasshand.com/login; the card requirement is not published on the pages read.
